detail.longDescription: New research from the AI Security Institute (AISI) shows how weak red-teaming creates dangerous false confidence in AI agent oversight, and why attacks trained on proxy monitors still transfer to production systems. Full breakdown of the findings and what they mean for enterprise AI teams: https://www. security.land/ai-monitors-atta ck-selection-false-confidence/ # SecurityLand # AISecurity # AISI # UK # Research # RedTeam # CyberSecurity # AI # ChatGPT
